title: Step 60-B backend and OpenAPI listing contract readiness
description: Make the public Search/Category/Listing API contract honest and typed before Storefront implementation. Define successful response schemas and cursor semantics for Search, Category products, Brand products, Category filters and Search suggestions; remove product-list query parameters that the backend does not yet implement; bind ProductCard to canonical refs; expose authoritative inventory-backed in_stock through the Inventory public port; regenerate OpenAPI types; add deterministic contract/runtime regression tests; and keep advanced interactive filtering/sorting implementation reserved for Stage 60-F.

evidence.bounded_availability_debt: Resolved in the current 60-B repair: public cards perform one Catalog batch sellable-variant lookup plus one Inventory batch availability lookup per page, independent of page variant multiplicity. acceptance_criteria.description: Fresh live guard proves main exact base, Open PRs zero, relevant Locks released and no competing Task Catalog writer.
Search, Category products, Brand products, Category filters, Category context and Search suggestions expose explicit successful response schemas in source OpenAPI and generated types.

GET /products no longer advertises min_price, max_price, available or selectable sort before those semantics are implemented; undeclared public listing query keys fail closed instead of being silently ignored.
Search contract includes q plus cursor/limit and keeps backend-owned relevance ordering; category listing includes cursor/limit/brand and keeps backend-owned newest ordering.
Public ProductCard price is explicitly nullable and availability.in_stock is derived through the canonical Inventory availability port, without cross-module repository access.
Category filter values are normalized to arrays and response schemas preserve canonical filter metadata.
src/generated/openapi.ts is byte-for-byte reproducible from contracts/http/openapi.yaml using openapi-typescript 7.13.0.
Root pnpm verify, build and relevant regression tests pass with no Storefront/runtime UI mutation.
Changed files remain exactly within the authorized Stage 60-B write scope.
Step56-A recovered-source evidence is deterministically synchronized for the two intentionally changed recovered sources, with no design-scope or historical-baseline rewrite.

All transitively affected Step56 B-G source-hash evidence, B-G manifest sourceSha256 values and Step56-H deterministic audit artifacts are synchronized solely from intentionally changed canonical sources; no wireframe/state/journey/permission/transport semantics or validators are rewritten.

Step57 foundation provenance is synchronized deterministically from the hash-only Step56 B-H changes while preserving all 134 surfaces, 24 journeys, operation authority, reviewStatus=PENDING and closure gates=PENDING; prototype outputs change only if canonical generator parity requires it.

Public listing/search pagination uses validated stable keyset cursors containing every ordering key needed for continuation; malformed cursors fail closed and same-timestamp page boundaries cannot skip rows.

Inventory availability authority is mandatory for public cards and listing availability is fetched with bounded batch calls through the Inventory public port, without Catalog querying Inventory tables.
Absent limit may default, but explicitly supplied non-integer, non-positive or above-contract public limits fail closed with canonical validation errors.

Public cursor input is length-bounded before decoding; public category/brand query scopes enforce canonical Slug syntax/length; category/brand scoped listing routes reject undeclared attempts to override their path-owned scope.
Protected merge transport, exact-SHA postmerge pnpm verify and Phase A pass, then terminal Lock release before 60-C.
